name: ci-watch
description: Watches the CI of your pull requests and starts a turn when a PR turns red, conflicts or is green to merge, so no agent sleep-polls CI. With loop=on (the default) it runs the lane loop: at most 3 fix tries per PR, merge on green under merge-policy, a watch of the deploy run of the merge commit, a staging verify turn, then one close-and-cleanup turn; at most 60 automatic turns a day, and no turn while ~/.claude/autonomy.off exists. fix_turns=off keeps the notifications and starts no turn for red CI and conflicts. Other mods and the model add a PR through the tool mcp__ci-watch__watch.

fix_turns.title: Fix turns
fix_turns.description: on: a red or conflicted PR starts a turn that fixes it. off: it only gets a toast and a notification; use off when another watcher (the desktop app Auto-fix) does the fix. The green path is the same for the two values.

loop.title: Lane loop
loop.description: on: the lane loop (fix tries counted to 3, decision records, merge under merge-policy, deploy watch, verify, close and cleanup turns, a cap of 60 automatic turns a day). off: ci-watch acts as in 0.2 (the kill switch file still stops every turn).
